status: phase-9 source-independent support revision, declared before new RF
source_contract: Fixed 5 mm anatomical guard on the central 8 rows (48 tissue pixels) and full 32-row tile (192); evaluator-only blood/tissue power <=.1 on both. Archive IQ even if a source check fails, and do not filter an ineligible scene.
calibration_contract: First 8 of 16 stationary tissue-only noisy prior frames fit a masked 0.4-pixel angular phase map; last 8 validate. Map is eligibility diagnostic only; regular filters receive original unmodified mixture IQ. Wide min train and validation coherence >=.7; core >=.5 and validation >=.85 train; maximum bounded input noise power gain <=4. No blood truth or evaluation IQ in gate.
candidate: Phase-8 mixture-only selector on guard 5; reference transport with frozen parameters or hybrid of accepted local phase at 0.6, Gaussian sigma 4, and half nonperiodic unitary shift. Evaluate paired SVD cut 1 and Axis 1 cut 1 against no motion. No tuning after seeds 3001/3019 RF.
decision: All eight new scenes must pass source/calibration and unchanged paired blood, moving tissue and slow Axis 2 gates; any missing or failed scene blocks 2333 and reserves. A success remains development evidence and needs separate prospective 2333 freeze.
